title: A sweep's work schedule (the review-triage skill)
description: The work units a review's findings are fixed in, in their order, and each finding's record from the sort. Read by triage.py, which checks a schedule against this schema and refuses one that doesn't match, naming the field. It holds the plan only: a unit's progress is read from its pull request and its findings' issues, never written here.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

sweep.description: The sweep's name, such as CR1.

units.description: The work units, in the order they are taken up. A unit is one pull request.

id.description: The unit's id, such as U07. Its pull request's description carries it in a marker.

name.description: What the unit changes, in a few words: "the sync loop".

findings.description: The issue numbers of its findings, most severe first.

files.description: Every file the unit's fixes change: code, tests, requirement sections, shared test data. Paths from the repository's root. Two units that share a file never run side by side.

depends_on.description: Optional. The ids of earlier units that must be merged first, whatever their files.

oversize.description: Optional. Why the unit holds more findings than the project's unit_size.

findings.description: Each finding's record from the sort.

readiness.description: ready: the remedy is clear and nothing in it is the owner's to choose. choice: it needs the owner's decision. check: it can't be sorted until a fact is known. not now: proposed as later work or as not planned.

depends_on.description: Optional. The findings that must be fixed before it, or that the same change fixes.

related.description: Optional. The findings that change the same function or turn on the same rule, without one having to come first: they are batched together where they fit, and asked together where they are choices.

size.description: small: one or two files and a test. medium: several files, or a proof that needs a container or a VM. large: a feature, or a change across a module.

proof.description: What proving the fix needs: a test, a container, a VM.

note.description: Optional. Anything the unit's session should know that the issue doesn't say.

set_aside.description: Optional. The open findings no unit holds, each with the reason.
